ticks.note: Tick 1 enters Waiting and its three copies of R, which wait for I == 1, 2 and 3 (their transitions are delayed).
I = 2: the copy with i = 2 moves to its final state D. The other two keep waiting.
The copy with i = 1 finishes. O is still false.
The last copy finishes, all regions are final and the join fires in the same tick: **O = true**.
